50.content: Screening mammogram on 2025-02-06 showed a developing asymmetry in the upper outer left breast. Diagnostic mammogram with tomosynthesis and targeted ultrasound demonstrate an irregular hypoechoic mass measuring 2.1 x 1.8 x 1.6 cm at the 2 o'clock position, 5 cm from the nipple. A single morphologically abnormal left axillary lymph node is identified with cortical thickening to 4 mm. BI-RADS 5, highly suggestive of malignancy. Ultrasound-guided core biopsy was recommended and completed on 2025-02-20. No right breast abnormality.
